clue.text: Workroom accommodating the boss and ten more

parts.note: a boss is a stud, a raised knob on a shield or surface
ten written as figures, 1 and 0, looks like the letters I and O

explanation.surface: A workshop with room for the manager and ten extra staff.
explanation.walkthrough: 'accommodating' and 'more' only join the pieces; ten is read as its digits 10, shaped like IO.
explanation.definitionFit: An artist's or photographer's place of work is a studio.

clue.text: A male put in control shows a certain craft

indicators.note: the two small pieces are placed inside the word meaning control

parts.note: to steer is to control direction

explanation.surface: A man given charge displays a particular skill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'craft' looks like a skill but is a vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A steam-powered ship is one kind of vessel.

clue.text: Hear some rubbish about quiet signalling system

indicators.note: the rearranged letters are placed around the quiet letter
rubbish suggests the two words hear and some are scrapped and rebuilt in a new order

parts.note: P is the musical abbreviation for piano, quiet

explanation.surface: Listen to some nonsense concerning a silent method of sending messages.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rubbish' turns HEARSOME into SEMAHORE, and 'about' wraps that round P after SEMA.
explanation.definitionFit: Flag-waving by arm positions is a visual code once used by navies and railways.

clue.text: Oriental copper or a Spanish woman

parts.note: the sen is a small Japanese coin, so a copper from the Orient
taken as written

explanation.surface: An Eastern coin, or else a lady from Spain.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'copper' in Britain is a low-value coin; the sen is a Japanese one.
explanation.definitionFit: Señora is the Spanish title and word for a married lady.

clue.text: A try-on must be dealt with, and that's official

indicators.note: dealing out cards mixes them, so these letters are shuffled

explanation.surface: An attempt to deceive must be handled, and that's formal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'official' reads as an adjective but is a noun, the anagram of A TRY ON.
explanation.definitionFit: A notary public is an official who certifies documents.

clue.text: Bloomers causing dreadful crisis after an upturn

indicators.note: the jumbled word follows the overturned piece
in a down clue an upturn reads the little word an from the bottom up
dreadful suggests the word crisis is badly mangled

explanation.surface: Underwear causing a terrible emergency once things go wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bloomers' looks like underwear but means flowers. 'upturn' gives NA, and 'dreadful' makes RCISSI from CRISIS.
explanation.definitionFit: Daffodils and their kin bloom in spring, so flowers are bloomers.

clue.text: Brown set about it, being a big man

indicators.note: the colour word is set around the little word it

parts.note: tan is a shade of light brown

explanation.surface: Brown went for it, as a large fellow would.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brown' reads as a surname but is the colour.
explanation.definitionFit: The Titans were giant gods of Greek myth, hence any powerful giant of a person.

clue.text: Reconciled or separated?

definitions.meaning: settled or sorted out, as a dispute
broken down into constituent parts, as light or a force

explanation.surface: Were they brought back together, or split apart?
explanation.definitionFit: Differences that are settled have been ended; a mixture or image broken into its components has been analysed into parts.

clue.text: Held in check-but note the warning sign!

parts.note: te is the seventh note of the tonic sol-fa scale
taken as written
red is the colour that signals danger

explanation.surface: Restrained, but pay attention to the danger signal!
explanation.walkthrough: 'note' looks like a verb meaning heed, but it supplies a musical note.
explanation.definitionFit: An animal tied with a rope is restrained in its movement.

clue.text: Object for examination

parts.note: pro means in favour of
a test is a trial or examination

explanation.surface: A thing put up for inspection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Object' reads as a noun but is the verb meaning complain.
explanation.definitionFit: To object is to complain or raise a formal dissent.

clue.text: Work force housed by an American lawyer

indicators.note: the word for force sits inside the lawyer's abbreviation

parts.note: a DA is a District Attorney, a US prosecutor
to ram is to force or push hard

explanation.surface: Labour force put up by a lawyer from the States.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Work force' looks like a single phrase about staff; it splits into the definition and RAM.
explanation.definitionFit: A play for the stage is a work of theatre.

clue.text: A relation may be made to give an explanation

indicators.note: these letters are to be made into something new, signalling a rearrangement

explanation.surface: A family member could be created to account for something.
explanation.definitionFit: A logical basis or reasoning behind a decision is its justification.

clue.text: Scoffed at over a point made

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits on top of the second

parts.note: E is east, a compass point

explanation.surface: Laughed at someone over a point being made.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scoffed' looks like mocked but means ate greedily.
explanation.definitionFit: To scoff food is to devour it.

clue.text: Get too fiery about a man returning thanks

parts.note: over can mean concerning, as in arguing over money
he is a male pronoun

indicators.note: the short word for thanks is written backwards

parts.note: ta is informal British for thank you

explanation.surface: Lose one's temper about a fellow giving thanks back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns TA into AT.
explanation.definitionFit: An engine running too hot exceeds its safe temperature.

clue.text: Cut amount due to daughter

parts.note: a score is a bill or reckoning, as in settle a score
D is the genealogical abbreviation for daughter

explanation.surface: Reduced the sum owed to a girl.
explanation.definitionFit: To score a surface is to incise lines into it.

clue.text: Force bamboozles attendants

parts.note: cons means swindles or tricks
a train is a retinue of followers

explanation.surface: Power confuses the servants.
explanation.definitionFit: To compel someone is to restrict them by pressure.

clue.text: Abuse is accepted by a Greek character-wise, that

indicators.note: the little word is taken inside the Greek letter

parts.note: mu is the twelfth letter of the Greek alphabet
taken as written
sage means wise

explanation.surface: Mistreatment is tolerated by a Greek, who is shrewd about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'character' looks like personality but is a letter; 'that' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: Wrong or improper use of something is misuse.

clue.text: Rent a rake

definitions.meaning: a tear or split, as in fabric

explanation.surface: Payment for lodgings, or a garden tool?
explanation.definitionFit: A tear in cloth is a split; a dissolute man about town is a libertine.

clue.text: Growth in the fold

parts.note: taken as written
a crease is a line made by folding

explanation.surface: Something growing inside the sheep pen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fold' suggests a sheep pen but is a crease.
explanation.definitionFit: A rise in size or number is a growth.

clue.text: By no means all periodicals are produced in the city

indicators.note: only part of the word periodicals is used, a run from within it

explanation.surface: Not every magazine is published in town.
explanation.definitionFit: Rio de Janeiro is a major Brazilian metropolis.

clue.text: Pay attention when the sovereign is cross!

parts.note: a sovereign is a pound coin, and L is the pound sign
taken as written
a cross, X, is the Roman numeral ten

explanation.surface: Take heed when the monarch is angry!
explanation.walkthrough: 'sovereign' looks like the monarch but is the gold pound coin; 'cross' looks like angry but is X.
explanation.definitionFit: To hear attentively is to heed.

clue.text: Copy a piece from a newspaper

indicators.note: only a fragment from within the word newspaper is wanted

explanation.surface: Reproduce an article from a newspaper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'piece' suggests an article but means a part of the word.
explanation.definitionFit: To mimic someone is to imitate them like a monkey.

clue.text: Person responsible for the mail putting wrong stamp on

indicators.note: wrong suggests the letters of stamp on are put out of place

explanation.surface: A mail carrier sticking the wrong stamp on.
explanation.definitionFit: The delivery worker who brings letters to the door.

clue.text: Travellers find it necessary to go to the left

parts.note: a go, or turn, in a card game can be a pass
port is the nautical left side

explanation.surface: Travellers find it essential to head left.
explanation.definitionFit: International travel requires an identity document issued by a state.

clue.text: Charming, but lacking central heating getting ready to do battle

indicators.note: lacking means the heating abbreviation is removed from charming

explanation.surface: Delightful, but with no heating, preparing for war.
explanation.definitionFit: Supplying oneself with weapons before war is equipping.

clue.text: Building-worker receiving a trainee for guidance

indicators.note: the worker word takes the trainee letter inside it

parts.note: a tiler lays tiles on roofs and floors
L is the learner, as on British L-plates

explanation.surface: A builder taking on an apprentice to show them the ropes.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a learner driver shows L-plates, so L is a trainee.
explanation.definitionFit: A boat's steering lever is what guides its course.

clue.text: Have a drink with the doorman, a fan

parts.note: to sup is to sip or drink
a porter guards a door or entrance

explanation.surface: Share a drink with the doorkeeper, an enthusiast.
explanation.definitionFit: A follower of a team is its backer.

clue.text: Go on following political leader displaying arrogance

indicators.note: the riding word comes after the leader's letter
the leader of political means its opening letter

parts.note: to ride is to go on a horse or bike

explanation.surface: Continue after the party chief shows haughtiness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Go on' reads as continue but means ride.
explanation.definitionFit: Excessive self-esteem is haughtiness.

clue.text: Value many a wild animal

parts.note: to rate is to value
L is the Roman numeral fifty, a crossword stand-in for many

explanation.surface: Many prize a creature of the wild.
explanation.definitionFit: The honey badger of Africa and Asia is a fierce wild mammal.

clue.text: Dress at home

parts.note: a habit is a monk's or nun's garment
taken as written

explanation.surface: Get dressed in one's own house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at home' looks like one phrase; it splits into AT and the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A natural environment where a species lives is its dwelling place.

clue.text: Say one meant it to be read out

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: read out suggests the letters of meant it are sorted out afresh

explanation.surface: Declare that someone intended it to be spoken aloud.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be read out' rearranges MEANTIT into NTIMATE.
explanation.definitionFit: To hint or make known is to suggest.

clue.text: See about the minister turning tough

indicators.note: the word see goes around the minister's title

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the short title is written backwards

parts.note: Rev is the abbreviation for Reverend, a minister

explanation.surface: Watch the clergyman become harsh.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning' makes VER from REV.
explanation.definitionFit: Harsh or strict treatment is hard.
